items.title: The canonical map from the normalised to the associated chain complex is split
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file simplicial.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted unit is the author's own lemma lemma-decompose-associated-complexes at source lines 4032-4043: for a simplicial object U of an abelian category the canonical morphism N(U) to s(U) is split, indeed s(U) is the direct sum of N(U) and a functorial complement D(U). The proof at source lines 4045-4113 defines D(U)_n as the image of the sum of the maps N(U_m) to U_n over all surjections [n] to [m] with m < n, uses the splitting lemma to see that this is complementary to N(U_n), and then verifies that D(U) is a subcomplex: the differential of an element of that image is a signed sum of maps U(varphi composed with the face maps), and each summand is shown to land in D(U) by ascending induction on m, with the top case m = n-1 handled separately through the simplicial identities between faces and degeneracies and the definition of N. The substance is the induction and the identification of the exceptional case, not the statement.
